title: Pulse of the Street: oil surge and rate hike fears trigger a market sell-off
text: Pulse of the Street: oil surge and rate hike fears trigger a market sell-off. Rising crude oil has pushed US-Treasury toward 5%, raising market expectations of a rate hike at the upcoming Fed meeting. Market participants brace for heightened volatility ahead of key policy decisions.
